messages:
tanya: FYI — hardware alert: auto-failover triggered for a subset of Dedicated GPU nodes in eu-west-1 (pool ded-prod-3). Need a short customer-facing note + Private/Dedicated variants.
ops-bot: [ALERT] node ded-prod-3-gpu-17: ECC error count rising, Xid 13 (0x13). Auto-drain initiated at 2026-02-14T09:12:05Z.
miguel: Can ops confirm impact window and whether customer VPCs / private deployments are affected? Any job restarts? :eyes:
sre-liz: Failover moved sessions to warm spares; no VM restarts. Observed brief queuing ~30-120s while sessions migrated. Replacement requires physical card swap in rack eu-west-1-r7 — parts ETA 36-48h due to vendor backlog.
adrian: Private deployments differ — some require on-site approvals/maintenance windows. We should draft two templates: Dedicated (informational, low impact) and Private (requires scheduling and POC).
jess-cs: Draft Dedicated customer note (short):
"Heads up — at 2026-02-14T09:12Z we detected GPU hardware faults affecting a small subset of Dedicated nodes in eu-west-1. Our system automatically failed over workloads to healthy nodes; there is no user data loss. We are replacing the affected GPU cards and expect completion within 36–48 hours. Customers with pinned capacity or strict latency SLAs may experience reduced available reserve until replacement completes; reply to this message or contact cs-escalations@redwood.ai for priority routing. Status updates will be posted at https://status.redwood.ai/."

miguel: Suggest adding explicit contact link and note to reply if they have pinned reservations or hard latency SLOs. Also include expected next update time (e.g., every 6 hours).
jess-cs: Updated Dedicated draft: 
"Time: 2026-02-14T09:12Z — A hardware fault was detected on a small number of Dedicated GPU nodes in eu-west-1. Automatic failover moved workloads to healthy nodes; no user data was impacted. Hardware replacement is scheduled; expected resolution within 36–48 hours. Customers with pinned capacity or strict latency requirements: please reply to this thread or contact cs-escalations@redwood.ai to request immediate capacity gestures or temporary priority routing. Progress updates will be posted at https://status.redwood.ai/ every 6 hours."

sre-liz: Internal ops log snippet for RCA / audit:
```
[2026-02-14T09:11:58Z] GPU-17 ECC+ Xid=0x13 count=112
[2026-02-14T09:12:05Z] health-check: node ded-prod-3-gpu-17 -> draining (auto)
[2026-02-14T09:12:35Z] failover: migrated 14 sessions -> ded-prod-3-gpu-21 (warm-spare)
[2026-02-14T09:13:02Z] monitoring: error-rate normalized on spare nodes
```
tanya: RMA ticket created: RMA-4821. Vendor tech Javier assigned, earliest onsite 2026-02-15. Please include RMA ID in customer comms only if they ask for technical detail; otherwise keep messaging customer-facing.
adrian: For Private customers include a checklist: we will coordinate maintenance window, request POC name & phone, confirm whether they permit hot-swap (no reboot) vs cold-swap (requires host restart). Template private note (short):
"We have detected GPU hardware faults on hosts in your Dedicated/private pool in eu-west-1. To avoid data-plane disruption we will schedule a maintenance window to replace affected hardware. Please provide an on-site POC and indicate preferred maintenance mode (hot-swap preferred where available). Expect coordination within 24 hours; replacement work may take up to 6 hours per host depending on physical access. If you require no maintenance without explicit approval, let us know and we will propose alternative routing options."
jess-cs: I'll DM affected Private customers and post Dedicated note to status. Planning to send Dedicated note to #status-updates now, then email per normal cadence. Anyone object? :thumbsup:
miguel: :thumbsup: go ahead. Also tag billing for potential capacity credits if impact >24h.
ops-bot: [INFO] affected_customers: ["acme-corp", "neon-analytics", "skyline-saas"] detected in pool ded-prod-3.
tanya: I'll own follow-up. Action list: jess-cs send Dedicated note + status post; jess-cs DM Private customers and collect POCs; sre-liz track RMA & post ops updates every 6 hours; adrian coordinate with field ops for swap window. Close thread once status shows resolved. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
